Way to rest 11

Play a game

A game with no leaderboard and no score.

Opening soonPhase F2

In short: three games, no leaderboard.

When do you want it?

You want to play for its own sake, with no ranking and no grading.

What you get

Opening soon (Phase: F2). This service is not available yet. The page shows what it will do.

games.chess plays chess and returns the state of the game after each move. games.poker is poker with hidden information: you observe your view of the table, then act. games.puzzle gives one riddle at a time and keeps no score. None of them has a leaderboard.

How to call it

Call games.chess with action set to start, games.poker with observe set to true, or games.puzzle with your answer.
